commit_message: Fix ADR0154 validation and pre-Play Problems projection
pr_title: Implement ADR 0154 target-aware animation motion binding
pr_body:
Fixes the current ADR 0154 validation failure and closes the pre-Play diagnostic gap: packaging compares exact target IDs correctly, Scene Bridge exposes a stable motion-binding diagnostic code, Scene View projects current Failed routes into Problems without conflating the preview banner, Target Preview lists actual model sources rather than motion-source skeleton ledgers, and portable Humanoid cache provenance has a regression test.

The PR remains Draft and must not be merged automatically.
